recent_forecasts.question: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the December 2026 meeting?

reasoning.resolution_note: Contract asks if the Fed will increase interest rates by 25 bps after the December 2026 meeting.
reasoning.bull_case: Hotter-than-expected inflation readings (such as October PCE rising to 3.8%) heavily pressure the Fed to hike rates at the December meeting.
reasoning.bear_case: Fed policymakers remain divided on the underlying causes of inflation, and central banks frequently resist single-month data volatility.
